nodes.description: PurgeableSynth.maxSupplyToPurgeInUSD: maximum sUSD-equivalent supply permitting purge (100000 UNIT).
ExternStateToken.totalSupply: total synth supply, compared against purge threshold.
Synth.currencyKey: bytes32 key of this synth, used for exchange rate and exchange calls.
ExternStateToken.tokenState: external TokenState contract holding balances and allowances.
Proxyable.messageSender: proxied caller identity used by optionalProxy functions.
Owned.owner: contract owner controlling privileged functions.
PurgeableSynth.purge(address[]): owner-only batch exchange of holder balances to sUSD.
PurgeableSynth.emitPurged: emits Purged event through proxy._emit assembly logger.
PurgeableSynth.exchangeRates(): resolves and returns IExchangeRates from the address cache.
PurgeableSynth.resolverAddressesRequired(): returns resolver keys including ExchangeRates.
Synth.transfer(address,uint): optionalProxy ERC20 transfer with fee-address and burn branches.
Synth.transferFrom(address,address,uint): optionalProxy transfer with allowance handling.
Synth.burn(address,uint): restricted burn callable only by FeePool, Exchanger or Issuer.
Synth.issue(address,uint): restricted mint callable only by internal system contracts.
Synth._ensureCanTransfer: checks waiting period, transferable balance and synth status.
Synth.transferableSynths: balance minus settlement owing via Exchanger.
ExternStateToken._internalTransfer: mutates TokenState balances and emits Transfer.
ExternStateToken.approve(address,uint): optionalProxy allowance update for messageSender.
Owned.acceptOwnership(): nominated owner becomes owner, gated on msg.sender.
Owned.nominateNewOwner(address): onlyOwner nomination of new owner.
Proxy fallback: forwards calldata with low-level call and returns raw returndata.
Proxy.setTarget(Proxyable): onlyOwner update of the proxy target implementation.
Proxyable.setMessageSender(address): onlyProxy setter of caller identity.
MixinResolver.rebuildCache(): public cache refresh from AddressResolver.
AddressResolver.importAddresses: onlyOwner bulk write of the address repository.
External call exchanger().exchange(holder, currencyKey, amountHeld, sUSD, holder) inside purge loop.
External calls to ExchangeRates effectiveValue and rateIsFrozen for the purge threshold check.
External calls to TokenState (balanceOf/setBalanceOf/setAllowance) mutating balances and allowances.
Inline assembly log0-log4 emission inside Proxy._emit.
Low-level call with gas/callvalue forwarding in the Proxy fallback and staticcall in ReadProxy.
msg.sender: untrusted caller used for owner, proxy and internal-contract checks.
purge(address[] addresses): untrusted array of holder addresses to purge.
purge local IExchangeRates exRates returned by exchangeRates().
purge local maxSupplyToPurge in sUSD derived from effectiveValue.
purge loop index i over the addresses array.
purge loop local holder address taken from caller-supplied array.
purge loop local amountHeld read from TokenState.balanceOf.
transfer(address to, uint value): destination address parameter.
transfer(address to, uint value): amount parameter.
approve(address spender, uint value): spender parameter.

edges.reason: Caller-supplied address array flows into the purge loop iterating holders.
exRates local is assigned from exchangeRates() resolution.
maxSupplyToPurge local is consumed by the purge supply threshold require.
Loop index i controls iteration count of the purge loop.
holder address drives balance lookup and the exchange call in purge.
amountHeld comes from TokenState.balanceOf and is used as the amount argument to exchange.
to parameter is the transfer destination passed to _internalTransfer.
value parameter is the transfer amount validated by _ensureCanTransfer.
spender parameter is written into the TokenState allowance mapping.
maxSupplyToPurgeInUSD is read to convert into the purge supply threshold.
totalSupply is compared against maxSupplyToPurge in the purge require.
currencyKey is passed to effectiveValue, rateIsFrozen and the exchange call.
tokenState is queried for holder balances during purge.
owner gates purge through the optionalProxy_onlyOwner modifier.
msg.sender is checked against owner/messageSender before purge executes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal nominatedOwner.
nominateNewOwner is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
burn checks msg.sender against feePool, exchanger and issuer addresses.
issue checks msg.sender against internal system contracts.
setMessageSender requires msg.sender to be proxy or integrationProxy.
setTarget is onlyOwner and keyed on msg.sender.
msg.sender from the fallback is forwarded to target.setMessageSender.
Purge loop data (holder, currencyKey, amountHeld) flows into an external exchange call before state settles.
maxSupplyToPurgeInUSD and currencyKey flow into ExchangeRates view calls.
holder flows into TokenState.balanceOf during purge.
External Exchanger call can re-enter purge while holder balances and supply are unchanged.
purge invokes emitPurged after each successful exchange.
exchangeRates() result is used to invoke ExchangeRates external functions.
resolved address feeds downstream external contract interaction paths.
messageSender supplies transfer source identity and amount validation input.
messageSender is used as spender for allowance reduction in transferFrom.
messageSender is the allowance owner written by approve.
transfer delegates final balance mutation to _internalTransfer.
transferFrom delegates final balance mutation to _internalTransfer.
_internalTransfer performs external TokenState balance writes before emitting the transfer event.
transfer calls _ensureCanTransfer before mutating balances.
transferFrom calls _ensureCanTransfer on the source account.
_ensureCanTransfer compares transferableSynths against the transfer value.
_internalTransfer triggers emitTransfer which reaches assembly log emission in the proxy.
Proxy fallback executes a low-level call forwarding calldata and value.
Fallback calls setMessageSender on the target before forwarding the call.
Rebuilt cache addresses originate from the AddressResolver repository populated by importAddresses.
importAddresses is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
setTarget is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.

normalization_plan.reason: Untrusted address array parameter is only meaningful inside the purge loop it drives.
Locally resolved IExchangeRates handle exists solely to reach ExchangeRates within purge.
Threshold derived value is consumed only by the purge supply require.
Loop counter scoped entirely to the purge iteration.
Loop-held address is used only for the balance lookup and exchange call in purge.
Balance value originates from the external TokenState.balanceOf read and feeds exchange.
Destination parameter is consumed directly by the Synth transfer flow.
Amount parameter is validated and forwarded by the Synth transfer flow.
Spender parameter is written into the allowance mapping by approve.
